spans.s: गुच्छः [gucchḥ], 1 A bundle, bunch (in general); गुच्छगुल्मं तु विविधम्
A bunch of flowers, a cluster of blossoms, a clump (of trees &c.); अक्ष्णोर्निक्षिपदञ्जनं श्रवणयोस्तापिच्छगुच्छावलिम्
A pearl necklace of 32 (or, according to some, of 7) strings; Kau.
. -Comp. -अर्धः a pearl necklace of 24 strings. (-र्धः, -र्धम्) half of a cluster. -कणिशः a kind of corn. -पत्रः the palm tree.
गुच्छालः [gucchālḥ], The plant Andropogon Schœnanthus (Mar. गवती चहा).
